text_blocks.snippet: Class 4 impact-resistant shingles are the highest-rated roofing materials available on the UL 2218 scale, designed to withstand the impact of a 2-inch steel ball dropped from 20 feet without cracking or splitting.
snippet_highlighted_words: the highest-rated roofing materials available on the UL 2218 scale

list.snippet: Severe Weather Defense: Protects against local hail, severe winds, and wind-driven debris.
Insurance Discounts: Many insurance companies operating in Utah offer annual premium discounts (ranging from 5% to over 30%) for upgrading to a Class 4 roof.
Cold-Weather Durability: Polymer-modified (SBS) asphalt types stay flexible in freezing Utah winter temperatures rather than becoming brittle.
